summary: Jonathan Wernke, 19, fell from a ledge near the Andy's Loop Trail area off Little Park Road ~10:45 p.m. Wednesday; group of climbers in the area called 911; Mesa County SO deputies + Mesa County SAR responded; Grand Junction Fire attempted life-saving measures but he did not survive; died of multiple blunt-force injuries, ruled accidental.
location: Andy's Loop Trail area off Little Park Road
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office; Mesa County Search and Rescue; Grand Junction Fire Department
notes: Date pinned to 2022-04-20 (a Wednesday) via Townsquare/News11 coverage: incident occurred Wednesday April 20th ~10:45 p.m.; victim identified over the following weekend.
